swingo.title: Swingo: Free Online Physics-Based Adventure Game
swingo.slogan: Swing, Navigate, and Conquer in Swingo!
swingo.description: Take on a swinging challenge in Swingo! Use ropes to navigate through tricky levels, dodge hazards, and collect coins in this physics-based adventure. Control an adorable bouncy character with a grappling hook, and aim to feed it with a delicious pear in each level. With seven worlds of increasing complexity and a timer feature, can you become the fastest winner? Unlock funny bouncy characters by conquering levels and enjoy unlimited hook drops. Play Swingo now and experience the thrill!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Swingo: Free Online Physics-Based Adventure Game
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Swingo is a physics-based adventure game where you control an adorable bouncy character using a grappling hook. Navigate through tricky levels, dodge hazards, and collect coins to feed the character with a delicious pear. With seven worlds of increasing complexity and a timer feature, Swingo offers a thrilling challenge for players of all ages.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the mouse or keyboard to control the character.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Adjust the direction of the hook and release to swing.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Collect coins and aim to feed the character with a pear in each level.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience realistic physics as you swing through levels with a grappling hook.
